card.name: Words just before toxicity or adverse reactions
card.fires_on: A linking word or word piece right before a expected term like toxicity or adverse reactions, e.g. 'disease progression or', 'dose-limiting', 'most common'.

modes.label: Until progression or toxicity
modes.description: The word 'or' after 'disease progression' in treatment-duration instructions, where 'unacceptable toxicity' comes next.
modes.example: Continue TEMODAR until disease progression<< or>> unacceptable toxicity.

modes.label: Dose-limiting / most common
modes.description: The ending of 'dose-limiting' or the word 'common' or 'of' just before adverse reactions or toxicity.

card.writes: It promotes side and symptom words, suggesting the next word is a side-effect term, and suppresses cancer and surgery words.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name a side effect or toxicity.
